name: Cross-Platform Dockerized Subagents
description: Run every Claude Flow Novice subagent inside a Docker container to guarantee memory controls while keeping identical behavior on Windows, macOS, Linux, WSL2, and CI.

businessCase.performanceGains: 10-30% faster on Windows native vs WSL2 due to reduced host process overhead
businessCase.reliabilityImprovements: Deterministic container memory limits instead of best-effort process management

phases.name: Docker Runtime Foundation
phases.description: Detect Docker availability, automate prerequisite installation, and gate CI on a healthy container runtime.

sprints.name: Docker Runtime Detection Module
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime detector created: src/runtime/docker-runtime.ts (250 lines)
Runtime types defined: src/runtime/runtime-types.ts (120 lines)
Detects Docker Desktop, Docker Engine, and containerd-backed CI environments
Validates minimum versions, resource quotas, and WSL2 backend availability on Windows
Provides actionable remediation messages when Docker is unavailable
Unit tests with 100% coverage: src/runtime/docker-runtime.test.ts (200 lines)

sprints.name: Host Prerequisite Automation
acceptanceCriteria: Installer/validation scripts created: scripts/windows/install-docker.ps1, scripts/macos/install-docker.sh, scripts/linux/install-docker.sh
Scripts verify Hyper-V/WSL features, Docker Desktop memory settings, and Linux cgroup v2 configuration
Documentation created: docs/docker-runtime-setup.md with screenshots and troubleshooting guides
Smoke test command `npm run verify:docker` executes and reports status
Validated on clean Windows 10/11, macOS 13+, Ubuntu 22.04 environments

sprints.name: CI/CD Container Gate
acceptanceCriteria: GitHub Actions workflow updated: .github/workflows/cross-platform-test.yml with docker sanity step
Matrix: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest] × [node-18, node-20, node-22]
Runtime detector invoked in CI and fails fast when Docker is unavailable
Baseline resource report generated: .artifacts/docker-baseline.json
Week 1 checkpoint report published

phaseAcceptanceCriteria: Docker runtime detector passes on Windows/macOS/Linux/CI
Installer scripts validated on clean machines
CI pipeline blocks merges when Docker is unhealthy

phases.name: Agent Image & Coordination Layer
phases.description: Build the claude-agent container image, migrate critical scripts inside it, and replace redis-cli/sqlite3 calls with Node adapters shared between host and container.

sprints.name: Agent Base Image
acceptanceCriteria: Dockerfile created: docker/agent/Dockerfile (120 lines)
Multi-stage build with Node 20, bash tooling, redis-cli, sqlite3, jq, rsync, git
Entrypoints defined for orchestration, worker, and maintenance flows
Image published to ghcr.io/claude-flow/agent:<sha>
Image build automation added to CI

sprints.name: Script Migration into Image
acceptanceCriteria: Top 20 critical bash scripts copied into /opt/cfn/scripts inside the image
Scripts parameterized via env vars and documented in planning/windows/SCRIPT_INVENTORY.md
Legacy host scripts updated to delegate to `docker exec` equivalents
Integration smoke tests confirm scripts run identically inside container

sprints.name: Redis & SQLite Node Adapters
acceptanceCriteria: Redis adapter created: src/coordination/redis-coordinator.ts (350 lines) using ioredis
SQLite adapter created: src/coordination/sqlite-adapter.ts (300 lines) using better-sqlite3
All 531 redis-cli/sqlite3 shell calls removed from host path
Adapters exposed to containers via mounted socket or HTTP bridge
Integration tests pass on Windows/macOS/Linux/CI

sprints.name: Week 2 Checkpoint
acceptanceCriteria: End-to-end CFN Loop runs with containers on Windows/macOS/Linux
No shell fallbacks to redis-cli/sqlite3 remain
Image publishing pipeline green across all branches
Week 2 completion report approved

phaseAcceptanceCriteria: Agent image built/published with signed digest
Redis/SQLite adapters replace shell commands completely
Containers can execute orchestrator workflows on all platforms

phases.name: Container Orchestration & Memory Controls
phases.description: Replace host-level process management with a Docker-based worker runner that enforces resource limits and emits telemetry.

sprints.name: Docker Worker Runner
acceptanceCriteria: Worker runner created: src/agents/docker-worker-runner.ts (500 lines)
Supports spawn(), stop(), status(), and log streaming via Docker Engine SDK
Handles Windows/macOS/Linux path translation and volume mounts
Ensures cleanup of containers/volumes even on crash
Unit tests + mocked engine tests passing

sprints.name: Resource Policies & Telemetry
acceptanceCriteria: Resource policy definitions added: config/resource-policies.json for MVP/Standard/Enterprise modes
Docker runner enforces --memory, --memory-swap, --cpus flags per policy
OOMKilled detection + retry logic implemented
Telemetry collector created: src/monitoring/docker-telemetry.ts (collects runtime, RSS, exit code)
Metrics exported to existing monitoring sink; alert on repeated OOM events

sprints.name: Developer Experience Enhancements
acceptanceCriteria: VS Code tasks/devcontainer updated for Docker-based agents
make/npm scripts updated (`npm run agent:start`, `npm run agent:logs`)
Troubleshooting guide for common Docker Desktop issues published
Week 3 checkpoint completed

phaseAcceptanceCriteria: All agent launches go through docker-worker-runner when flag enabled

phases.name: Validation & Rollout
phases.description: Execute cross-platform validation, long-running memory tests, documentation updates, and feature-flagged rollout.

sprints.name: Cross-Platform & Memory Testing
acceptanceCriteria: Full CFN Loop suite passes on Windows/macOS/Linux/CI with Docker flag on
1000-cycle memory leak test finishes with <0.1% growth and zero orphaned containers
Performance regression <10% vs baseline on Linux/Mac; Windows sees ≥10% I/O improvement
Artifacts produced: .artifacts/perf-comparison.json, .artifacts/memory-leak.json

sprints.name: Documentation & Migration Guide
acceptanceCriteria: README + CHANGELOG updated with Docker requirements
User migration guide created: planning/windows/USER_DOCKER_MIGRATION_GUIDE.md
Support playbook updated with troubleshooting + rollback steps
Internal enablement session delivered

sprints.name: Feature Flag Rollout
acceptanceCriteria: Feature flag CFN_USE_DOCKER_SUBAGENTS defaulted to true in canary channels
Beta release published: v2.15.0-beta.1 with Docker mode enabled
Monitoring dashboards configured for canary cohort
Rollout criteria + rollback steps documented
Go/No-Go meeting completed

phaseAcceptanceCriteria: All Docker-enabled tests pass across platforms
